name: Rattlebunch
look: four radish rats bundled together like a bunch of radishes, their leafy tops knotted in twine into a leafy crown, a face looking each way
entry: Several Raddent whose leaves grew tangled together in the same patch, tied fast with a farmer's twine. They argue constantly about which way to run, but when they agree, nothing can catch them.
how: Wild: rare in plains and grasslands.
